## Recommendation for Headcount Phase
Model direct headcount against the Q3 Forecast volume trajectory, starting with Respiratory & Immunology.

signals.title: RSG programme: up to USD 2.0B of restructuring to tag once and track to Core through 2029
signals.source: AstraZeneca 9M & Q3 2026 results (30 Oct 2026) — Reshaping for Sustainable Growth
signals.excerpt: Reshaping for Sustainable Growth is expected to cost up to USD 2.0B in one-time restructuring and to deliver USD 1.5B of annualised pre-tax run-rate benefits, essentially complete by the end of 2029. Each charge needs one tag that flows into provisions, the Reported-to-Core bridge and the controls evidence, instead of being rebuilt in each entity workbook.

signals.title: Provision 29 declaration for FY2026: 37 control deficiencies open, 2 rated significant
signals.source: SDP Controls & Non-Financial Risk — 1,284 key controls
signals.excerpt: The UK Corporate Governance Code Provision 29 board declaration on material controls applies from FY2026. Of 1,284 key financial and non-financial controls in scope, 92% have been tested for the year and 46% are tested automatically from Snowflake data. 37 deficiencies are open; the two significant ones are SAP access in China and third-party HCP payment approvals.
